item.title: LDH announces update to Medicaid managed care contracts for 2026
item.description: The Louisiana Department of Health (LDH) announced it will not renew its contract with the managed care organization (MCO) UnitedHealthcare beyond the current contract expiration date of December 31, 2025. This decision comes as LDH reaches the end of the three-year contract cycle for its six Medicaid MCOs.
